insights.text: Unifying crates/designos-app/src/theme.rs with design/design.tokens.json and replacing purple component accents with #06B6D4 Cyan while raising colors.neutral to #6e6e77 eliminates all WCAG AA contrast failures and lifts curator scores above 95.

Enforcing Z01..Z12 Zero Fake UI gates on Home workspace section filters and separating section count badges into monospace Badge/StatusCount pills (D85) prevents silent data fallbacks and visual label clutter.

Combining Figma C++/WASM flat SoA SceneIndex + DirtyLog O(k) GPU sync with per-file isolated PTY terminals (procedural box-drawing + canvas shortcut suppression) sustains 60fps while running live CLI design agents.

Font glyphs for Unicode box-drawing characters (U+2500..U+257F) often introduce subpixel gaps or seams at fractional display scaling. Rendering box-drawing characters procedurally as pixel-snapped geometric quads guarantees seamless borders and tables across all zoom levels and DPI scales.

Pointer-chasing deep hierarchical scene graph trees during pan and zoom culling causes CPU cache misses. Flattening spatial bounding boxes (AABBs), visibility flags, and page membership into contiguous Structure-of-Arrays (SoA) slices enables vectorizable, cache-efficient frustum culling.

Rebuilding or re-uploading complete vertex and instance buffers on every canvas mutation scales with total document size O(N). Appending modified node IDs to a bounded dirty log allows frame preparation to patch only the dirty GPU buffer slots in O(k) time.

Empty collection filters must render explicit, contextual empty states rather than silently falling back to a default dataset; silent fallbacks mask missing items and mislead users into modifying the wrong scope.
Single token authority between crates/designos-app/src/theme.rs and design/design.tokens.json eliminates multi-palette border clashes and enforces the Purple Ban across all studio surfaces.
